# Mission Hub — agent index

Standalone mission + execution-trace service: durable missions, claims/leases, runs, summaries and
evidence, exposed through **two parity surfaces**, REST and MCP. Product version `0.1.0`, agent
contract revision `v3.2`.

## Read first

- [`docs/AGENT_USAGE.md`](./docs/AGENT_USAGE.md) — how agents use the service
- [`docs/AGENT_ROLES.md`](./docs/AGENT_ROLES.md) — role and scope model
- [`docs/AUTONOMOUS_AGENTS.md`](./docs/AUTONOMOUS_AGENTS.md) — unattended workflows
- [`docs/RUNTIME_ADAPTERS.md`](./docs/RUNTIME_ADAPTERS.md) — per-runtime integration
- [`docs/contract-inventory.json`](./docs/contract-inventory.json) — machine inventory of enums, scopes, tables, routes, MCP tools
- [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) — repository rules for agents

## Invariants

- **REST ↔ MCP parity.** Every agent-facing read/write exists on both surfaces unless documented
  otherwise; `pnpm test:contract-inventory` fails on drift.
- **Missions are never closed by an agent.** State transitions to `done` are an operator decision.
- **Claims are leases, not locks.** `mission.status` never acts as a mutex; reclaim goes through
  expiry and fencing.
- **Evidence, not prose.** A claimed result carries a run, a typed summary and evidence references.

## Commands

```bash
pnpm dev
pnpm db:migrate
pnpm test
pnpm test:contract-inventory   # contract drift gate
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
```
